primary.title: Gold jumps 9% in August as weaker dollar, easing Fed bets boost demand
primary.summary: Gold prices are on a winning streak as US Fed rate hike expectations ease and a weaker dollar boosts overseas demand. Spot gold reached $4,397 an ounce, marking a 9% monthly gain in August, while remaining below January's all-time high of $5,602.
